   "id": "52f2dcae",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Tuning across cavity types\n",
    "\n",
    "Every cavity model declares its own tuning handles — there is no fixed list.\n",
    "The tuner asks the model what it can vary, so the same `cav.tune.run(...)` call\n",
    "works whether the handle is an elliptical equator radius, a pillbox radius, a gun\n",
    "wall radius, or a spline control point. Here we tune four different geometries to\n",
    "a target frequency and compare.\n",
    "\n",
    "See the [tuning guide](../../tuning)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "bb47b15d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-25T20:13:29.829380Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-25T20:13:29.829157Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.173409Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.172531Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "from cavsim2d import EllipticalCavity, Pillbox, RFGun, SplineCavity, Study\n",
    "from cavsim2d.utils.style import apply_style\n",
    "\n",
    "apply_style()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3bafcb9b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Four cavities, four handles\n",
    "\n",
    "Each cavity is paired with a geometry handle and a target frequency. A model's\n",
    "`tune_variables()` lists everything it is willing to vary."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "89e71648",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.176404Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.175960Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.184243Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.183644Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "elliptical  handle Req   ->  1300.0 MHz\n",
      "pillbox     handle Req   ->  1300.0 MHz\n",
      "rf gun      handle R6    ->   210.0 MHz\n",
      "spline      handle p2_r  ->  1300.0 MHz\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "GUN = {'geometry': {'y1': 1.5e-2, 'R2': 3e-2, 'T2': np.deg2rad(45), 'L3': 24e-2,\n",
    "                    'R4': 5e-2, 'L5': 11e-2, 'R6': 6e-2, 'L7': 19e-2, 'R8': 4e-2,\n",
    "                    'T9': np.deg2rad(8), 'R10': 3e-2, 'T10': np.deg2rad(40),\n",
    "                    'L11': 5e-2, 'R12': 3e-2, 'L13': 3e-2, 'R14': 3e-2, 'x': 1e-2}}\n",
    "SPLINE = {'geometry': {'p0': [0, 35], 'p1': [0, 70], 'p2': [30, 103],\n",
    "                       'p3': [85, 103], 'p4': [115, 70], 'p5': [115, 35]}}\n",
    "\n",
    "jobs = [\n",
    "    ('elliptical', EllipticalCavity(1, [42, 42, 12, 19, 35, 57.7, 108.0],\n",
    "                                    [42, 42, 12, 19, 35, 57.7, 108.0],\n",
    "                                    [42, 42, 12, 19, 35, 57.7, 108.0], beampipe='none'),\n",
    "     'Req',  1300.0),\n",
    "    ('pillbox',    Pillbox(1, [100, 100, 20, 0, 50], beampipe='none'),   'Req',  1300.0),\n",
    "    ('rf gun',     RFGun(GUN),                                           'R6',    210.0),\n",
    "    ('spline',     SplineCavity(SPLINE),                                 'p2_r', 1300.0),\n",
    "]\n",
    "for name, cav, handle, target in jobs:\n",
    "    print(f\"{name:11s} handle {handle:5s} -> {target:7.1f} MHz\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2cdac787",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Tune each to its target\n",
    "\n",
    "The call is identical for every model; only the handle name changes. We record the\n",
    "starting frequency, the frequency the tuner reports, and the frequency of an\n",
    "independent re-solve of the tuned cavity — the strict check that it really\n",
    "landed on target."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "8237f1b5",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.187002Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-25T20:13:32.186774Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.248714Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.247944Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "rows = []\n",
    "tuned_cavs = []\n",
    "for name, cav, handle, target in jobs:\n",
    "    study = Study(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), name))\n",
    "    study.add_cavity(cav, name.replace(' ', '_'))\n",
    "    cav.eigenmode.run({'polarisation': 'monopole', 'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}})\n",
    "    f0 = cav.eigenmode.qois['freq [MHz]']\n",
    "\n",
    "    study.run_tune({'freqs': target, 'cell_type': {'mid-cell': handle},\n",
    "                    'processes': 1, 'rerun': True, 'maxiter': 30,\n",
    "                    'eigenmode_config': {'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}}})\n",
    "    f_tuner = cav.tune.qois['mid-cell']['FREQ']\n",
    "\n",
    "    cav.tuned.eigenmode.run({'polarisation': 'monopole', 'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}})\n",
    "    f_res = cav.tuned.eigenmode.qois['freq [MHz]']\n",
    "    rows.append({'cavity': name, 'handle': handle, 'start [MHz]': round(f0, 1),\n",
    "                 'target [MHz]': target, 'tuner [MHz]': round(f_tuner, 2),\n",
    "                 're-solved [MHz]': round(f_res, 2)})\n",
    "    tuned_cavs.append((name, cav))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "39735485",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Summary\n",
    "\n",
    "Every geometry reaches its target, and the independent re-solve of `cav.tuned`\n",
    "agrees with it to the table's 0.01 MHz — the tuned cavity really sits on target. The\n",
    "tuner solves on the mesh given in the tune's `eigenmode_config`, so a re-solve on that\n",
    "mesh sees the same cavity; on a different mesh the frequency moves by that mesh's\n",
    "discretisation error."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "9d643e3e",

   "source": [
    "## Geometry before and after tuning\n",
    "\n",
    "Every model, before (blue) and after (red) tuning its own handle to the target frequency."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "6b91c65d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.273593Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.273299Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.812818Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-09-25T20:16:35.812121Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1100x700 with 4 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 7))\n",
    "for (name, cav), ax in zip(tuned_cavs, axs.ravel()):\n",
    "    cav.plot('geometry', ax=ax, show=False, color='C0', label='before')\n",
    "    cav.plot('geometry', ax=ax, tuned=True, show=False, color='C3', label='after')\n",
    "    ax.set_title(name)\n",
    "    ax.legend(fontsize=8)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  }
